sect1.title: How to write the input file
sect1.para: The input file consists of key-value pairs where each key represents a specific setting. Each parameter should be written in the following format:
Lines beginning with # or ! are considered as comments and they would be ignored.
Tags in this section is about simulatation parameters such as file path, numerical parameters.

sect2.title: method
sect2.para: Description: CCE Methods to calculate the dynamics of the system.
You can specify this value via the "-m" command-line option.

sect2.title: quantity
sect2.para: Description: Quantity to calculate the dynamics of the system.
You can specify this value via the "-q" command-line option.

sect2.title: order
sect2.para: Description: Order of the CCE method.

sect2.title: bfield
sect2.para: You can specify a magnetic field along the z-axis via the "-B" command-line option.
Data Type: Float or Float List

sect2.title: nstate
sect2.para: Description: Number of state templates to be generated.
You can specify this value via the "-N" command-line option.

entry.para: No state template will be generated (Ensemble approach)
State template will be generated (Single-sample approach) Mean-field effect will be automatically added

sect2.title: seed
sect2.para: Description: Seed for random number generator. If you want to generate the same state templates, you should set the same seed value.

sect2.title: qubitfile
sect2.para: Description: File path of the qubit spatial configuration. This tag is required when you use the qubit configuration file. Also, this only supports for a single qubit system.

para.preformatted: example) 10.0 12.0 13.0 - x,y,z position of qubit in cartesian, angstrom

sect2.title: gyrofile
sect2.para: Description: File name including bath spin information, e.g. gyromagnetic ratio, spin number

para.preformatted: File format is the following : [Name] [SpinNumber] [Gyromagnetic ratio (rad/ms/G)]

sect2.title: bathfile
sect2.para: Description: File name of the bath spatial configuration. You can specify this value via the "-I" command-line option.

para.preformatted: example) 1.0 0.0 0.0 0.0 - Total line number 1.0 2.0 3.0 13C - x,y,z in cartesian, angstrom 4.0 5.0 6.0 P1 - Spin name should be the same to the name in gyrofile

sect2.para: Data Type: String (File path) or String List

sect2.title: bathadjust
sect2.para: Description: Adjust the bath configuration. If you want to adjust the bath configuration, you can set the bathadjust value. Usually, this tag is required for multiple qubit calculation that wouldb have different bath configuration

sect2.title: avaaxfile
sect2.para: Description: File path of the principal axis of the bath spin. This tag might require during paramagnetic defect bath simulation. During PM defect bath simulation, if you don\'t give this file, the principal axes are automatically assigned.

You can specify this value via the "-a" command-line option.
File format is the following : [Principal axis index]
example) 5.0 - The number of total line 1.0 - principal axis index 2.0 - : 3.0 3.0

sect2.title: statefile
sect2.para: Description: File name of the bath state template. This tag might require when you want to obtain the result for a certain set of initial bath state. If the file path of the statefile doesn\'t exist, the program will automatically generate the state template. You can specify this value via the "-s" command-line option.

para.preformatted: example) 5.0 - The number of total line -0.5 - Spin sublevel when S=1/2 0.5 - : -0.5 -0.5

sect2.title: exstatefile
sect2.para: Description: File name of the additional bath spin state template. This tag might require when you want to calculate paramagnetic defect bath. Each bath state represent the additional bath spin state. If the file path of the exstatefile doesn\'t exist, the program will automatically generate the state template. You can specify this value via the "-S" command-line option.

para.preformatted: example) 5.0 - The number of total line -1.0 - Spin sublevel when S=1 0.0 - : 1.0 -1.0

sect2.title: DefectTotSpin
sect2.para: Description: Total spin number of the qubit. (Required when you use Hyperfine tensor file obtained by QUANTUM ESPRESSO)

sect2.title: CorrTotSpin
sect2.para: Description: Spin number correction (Required when you use Hyperfine tensor file obtained by QUANTUM ESPRESSO)

sect2.title: hf_readmode
sect2.para: Description: Interaction tensor between qubit and bath spins can be determined by this option. If you want to use the hyperfine tensor obtained from DFT calculation, you should set this option.

sect2.title: hf_tensorfile
sect2.para: Description: File name of the hyperfine tensor. This tag is required when you use the hyperfine tensor obtained from DFT calculation.

sect2.title: hf_ignore_oor
sect2.para: Description: Even if the bath spin is within the specified range set in the hyperfine tensor, if the code cannot find a matching spin relative position and spin tensor, it may or may not raise an error depending on this option.

sect2.title: qd_readmode
sect2.para: Quadrupole interaction tensor of bath spins can be set by this option. If you want to use the Quadrupole tensor obtained from DFT calculation, you should set this option.

sect2.title: Qubit
sect2.para: Description: Qubit information. This tag is required to give the details of qubit information.

sect2.title: nqubit
sect2.para: Description: Number of qubits in the system. The number of qubit information in tag Qubit should be the same as this value.

sect2.title: qubit
sect2.para: Description: Qubit information details, e.g. qubit name, spin number, gyro magnetic ratio, etc.. This tag is required to give the details of qubit information.

listitem.para: xyz : x,y,z position of qubit in cartesian, angstrom

sect2.title: spin
sect2.para: Description: Spin number of the qubit.

sect2.title: gyro
sect2.para: Description: Gyromagnetic ratio of the qubit.

sect2.title: xyz
sect2.para: Description: x,y,z position of the qubit in cartesian coordinates.

sect2.title: detuning
sect2.para: Description: Detuning frequency of the qubit.

sect2.title: alphams
sect2.para: Description: Alpha state of the qubit. Represents one of the effective spin states of the qubit. Priority: psia > alphaidx > alphams. This tag is ultimately applied to set QubitArray::psia (i.e. psia), unless it is overridden by a higher-priority tag

sect2.title: betams
sect2.para: Description: Beta state of the qubit. One of the effective spin states of the qubit. Priority: psib > betaidx > betams. This tag is ultimately applied to set QubitArray::psib (i.e. psib), unless it is overridden by a higher-priority tag

sect2.title: intmap
sect2.para: Description: Interaction map between qubits. This tag is required to define the interaction map between qubits, including its self interaction (e.g. Zero-field splitting).

sect2.title: between
sect2.para: Description: Names of an interacting qubit pair. This tag is required to define the interaction map for a specific qubit pair. For zero-field splitting interactions, the qubit names must be identical. (e.g. ["q1","q1"] )

sect2.title: tensor
sect2.para: Description: Interaction tensor. This tag is required to define the interaction tensor for a specific qubit pair. This tensor is used to calculate the interaction between qubits.

sect2.title: psia
sect2.para: Description: Alpha state of the qubit in matrix representation. One of the effective spin states of the qubit in matrix representation, simbol : |alpha⟩ . Priority: psia > alphaidx > alphams.
Default: - (If not entered, alphams state would be the )

sect2.title: psib
sect2.para: Description: Beta state of the qubit in matrix representation. One of the effective spin states of the qubit in matrix representation, simbol : |beta⟩ . Priority: psib > betaidx > betams.

sect2.title: psi0
sect2.para: Description: Initial state of the qubit in matrix representation, symbol: |psi0⟩ This tag is used to define a specific initial state of the qubit. If this tag is not provided, the initial state defaults to |psi0⟩ = |alpha⟩ + |beta⟩ .

sect2.title: overhaus
sect2.para: Description: Overhauser field of the qubit. This tag is required to compute spin dynamics including the Overhauser field of the qubit.

sect2.title: alphaidx
sect2.para: Description: Alpha state of the qubit. (Adiabatic state of the qubit system) Use this tag to assign the eigenvector of the diagonalized qubit Hamiltonian as the initial qubit state. Priority: psia > alphaidx > alphams. This tag is ultimately applied to set QubitArray::psia (i.e. psia), unless it is overridden by a higher-priority tag

sect2.title: betaidx
sect2.para: Description: Beta state of the qubit. (Adiabatic state of the qubit system) Use this tag to assign the eigenvector of the diagonalized qubit Hamiltonian as the initial qubit state. Priority: psib > betaidx > betams. This tag is ultimately applied to set QubitArray::psib (i.e. psib), unless it is overridden by a higher-priority tag

sect2.title: addsubclus
sect2.para: Description: For CCE simulations with order ≥ 3, enabling this option allows all sub-clusters of the highest order to be included. This leads to more stable and robust results, and may also reduce computation time.

sect2.title: nk
sect2.para: Description: Number of clusters for each CCE order. This is useful for CCE simulations with order ≥ 3, leading tons of clusters If the value is [0,0,0], it means that all clusters are included.

sect2.title: npulse
sect2.para:
Description: Number of pulses in the pulse sequence. This tag is required to define the number of pulses in the pulse sequence. Removed Todo
Hyeonsu

sect2.title: pulsename
sect2.para:
Description: Name of the pulse sequence. Removed Todo

sect2.title: Defect
sect2.para: Description: Detailed information of paramagnetic (PM) defect bath can be provided by this tag.

listitem.para: naddspin : Number of on-site nuclear spins of the PM defect
navaax : Number of possible principal axes of the defect
spins : Spin numbers of the on-site nuclear spins
gyros : Gyromagnetic ratio of the on-site nuclear spins
eqs : eQ values of the on-site nuclear spins
rxyzs : Relative x,y,z position of on-site nuclear spins

sect2.title: dfname
sect2.para: Description: Name of the paramagnetic defect.

sect2.title: apprx
sect2.para: Description: If apprx is set to false, the electron and nuclear spins of the paramagnetic defect are clusterized separately. This corresponds to a conventional CCE simulation for all spins. If apprx is set to true, the electron and nuclear spins are treated as one set, resulting in a simulation based on the CCE-NeNn method.

sect2.title: naddspin
sect2.para: Description: Number of on-site nuclear spins of the paramagnetic defect.

sect2.title: navaax
sect2.para: Description: Number of possible principal axes of the paramagnetic defect.

sect2.title: types
sect2.para: Description: Name of on-site nuclear spins of the paramagnetic defect. The number of types should be the same as naddspin.

sect2.title: spins
sect2.para: Description: Spin numbers of the on-site nuclear spins of the paramagnetic defect. The number of spins should be the same as naddspin.

sect2.title: gyros
sect2.para: Description: Gyromagnetic ratio of the on-site nuclear spins of the paramagnetic defect. The number of gyros should be the same as naddspin.

sect2.title: eqs
sect2.para: Description: Quadrupole moment (eQ) values of the on-site nuclear spins of the paramagnetic defect. The number of eQ values should be the same as naddspin.

sect2.title: rxyzs
sect2.para: Description: Relative x,y,z position of on-site nuclear spins of the paramagnetic defect over the electron spin position. The number of rxyzs should be the same as " naddspin x navaax "

sect2.title: hypf
sect2.para: Description: The hyperfine interaction between on-site nuclear spins and the electron spin associated with a paramagnetic defect. The number of hypf should be the same as " naddspin x navaax "

sect2.title: efg
sect2.para: Description: The electric field gradient tensors of the paramagnetic defect. The number of efg should be the same as " naddspin x navaax "

sect2.title: zfs
sect2.para: Description: The zero-field splitting tensors of the electron spin associated with a paramagnetic defect. The number of zfs should be the same as " navaax "

sect2.title: detuning
sect2.para: Description: Detuning frequencies that will be applied to the electron spin associated with the paramagnetic defect. The number of detuning should be the same as " navaax " This tag is used to approximate the spin interaction tensors related to the paramagnetic defect, e.g., \[ \vec{S} \cdot \mathbf{A} \cdot \vec{I} \approx \Delta m_I S_z \].

sect2.title: savemode
sect2.para: Description: The output file can be saved in different ways.

listitem.para: "all" : Saves all coherence functions for each cluster and each state. The file name will be in the format: "output_{cluster}_state{state}_wiDiv/noDiv"
"normal" : Saves coherence functions for each state only. The file name will be in the format: "output_state{state}_wiDiv/noDiv"

sect2.title: outfile
sect2.para: Description: Output file name prefix. "outfile_..._wiDiv" is the final result of the coherence function. "outfile_..._noDiv" is the result without dividing the final coherence function into those obtained from its sub-clusters. You can specify this value via the "-o" command-line option.
